column1: # One exact git-tracked path per line (relative to repo root). Blank lines
# and lines starting with '#' are ignored. This file was seeded by grepping
# `git ls-files` for the gate's banned extensions at adoption time: the
# result was empty, so this policy starts with ZERO exemptions (the gate is
# green today with no allowlisted binaries at all).
# Add a row only for a binary that is genuinely meant to be committed (e.g. a
# small logo asset a doc renders inline) — never to silence a screenshot or
# generated build artifact; those route to an artifact store / PR attachment
# instead, per the gate's own fail message.
